concurrency_and_state: NpcFactory.PLAYERID_OBJECT (src/models/npc/NpcFactory.java:49) is a static non-thread-safe HashMap accessed concurrently from Netty threads via NpcService.createMenuConMeo (NpcService.java:31), NpcFactory.createNpcConMeo, and ThanVuTru.confirmMenu (ThanVuTru.java:174).
NpcFactory.java:481-485 uses ordered locking on Player objects (firstLock = player.id < pl.id ? player : pl) for OTT_ACCEPT gold wagering to prevent deadlocks.
NpcFactory.java:666-668 synchronizes on player.inventory.itemsBoxCrackBall when clearing lucky round items.
SmartDropService.isSlotAcquired (src/services/map/SmartDropService.java:171-185) synchronizes on zone.items while iterating ground drops.

WeatherService.activeWeatherMap (src/services/map/WeatherService.java:24) is a ConcurrentHashMap storing unsynchronized ArrayList<EffectMap> instances shared with Map.effMap, mutated in setWeather without locking.

MapService.gI() uses double-checked locking with volatile (src/services/map/MapService.java:20-31), whereas ChangeMapService, ItemMapService, NpcService, SmartDropService, and WeatherService use un-synchronized lazy singleton initialization.
cross_module_questions: Verify Player.setClothes.checkSetDes() return value polarity: Whis.java:73 blocks access to Heaven Gear crafting when checkSetDes() returns true ("Ngươi hãy trang bị đủ 5 món trang bị Hủy Diệt rồi ta nói chuyện tiếp").
Verify ConsignShopManager.getItemById / updateItemUpTopAsync thread-safety when UP_TOP_ITEM (NpcFactory.java:762-789) mutates ConsignItem.isUpTop concurrently with item purchase/cancel.
Verify Client-side handling of Message(-91), Message(29), Message(32), Message(38), Message(-105) for EOF edge cases when optional fields (e.g. avatar != -1 in NpcService.java:49,66,80) are omitted.

db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Called without checking if clan != null or clan.isLeader(player) in CONFIRM_DISSOLUTION_CLAN.
Updates consign item isUpTop without locking the ConsignItem against concurrent buy/cancel.
Persists player after gem deduction in UP_TOP_ITEM.

findings.impact: Concurrent Netty worker thread mutations can cause NPE, lost entries, or corrupted buckets; uncleaned keys retain Player/Item references until server restart.
findings.root_cause: NpcFactory.PLAYERID_OBJECT is a plain HashMap shared across threads, and multiple menu handlers (MAKE_FRIEND, CONFIRM_NHUONG_PC, BAN_PLAYER, BUFF_PET, SUB_MENU, MENU_FIND_PLAYER, ThanVuTru) or cancelled menus never remove entries.
findings.title: Non-thread-safe HashMap and memory leak in NpcFactory.PLAYERID_OBJECT

findings.impact: Players who fail the map 169 task/power check in checkMapCanJoin still lose 50M gold without entering the map.
findings.root_cause: Whis.vaoMapHD deducts 50,000,000 gold (requiring strictly > COST_HD) before calling ChangeMapService.changeMapBySpaceShip, which later rejects entry if TaskService.getIdTask < TASK_25_0.
findings.title: Whis.vaoMapHD deducts 50M gold before map entry validation

findings.impact: A player denied entry to a map (checkMapCanJoin returns null) can still have their Namek Dragon Ball dropped or tracking arrays overwritten.
findings.root_cause: changeMap mutates NgocRongNamecService.mapNrNamec/zoneNrNamec and calls dropNamekBall(pl) before checkMapCanJoin(pl, zoneJoin) validates whether the player can actually enter zoneJoin.
findings.title: ChangeMapService mutates Namek Dragon Ball state before checkMapCanJoin validation

findings.impact: Players with exactly 1,500,000 power pass checkMapCanJoin, are moved into map 111 and receive mapInfo, then get resetPoint and a rejection message.
findings.root_cause: checkMapCanJoin checks power > 1500000L, whereas post-join code at line 444 checks power >= 1_500_000L after goToMap and zoneJoin.mapInfo have already executed.
findings.title: Off-by-one power check and late rejection on map 111

findings.impact: Clicking "Hướng dẫn" at Tapion when the 22h event is closed does nothing.
findings.root_cause: openBaseMenu opens menu ConstNpc.MENU_NOT_OPEN_MMB, but confirmMenu handles ConstNpc.MENU_NOT_OPEN_BDW.
findings.title: Tapion confirmMenu checks wrong menu constant when event is closed

findings.impact: Players can enable offline auto-training for free without having or spending 1 gem.
findings.root_cause: Menu option 1 advertises "Đồng ý\n1 ngọc\nmỗi lần", but confirmMenu sets player.dangKyTapTuDong = true without checking or deducting gem.
findings.title: Auto-training registration does not check or deduct advertised 1 gem cost

findings.impact: Concurrent setWeather and Zone.mapInfo reads can throw ConcurrentModificationException; broadcastWeatherToMap resends full map info (-24) to all players in all zones.
findings.root_cause: WeatherService stores plain ArrayLists in activeWeatherMap/Map.effMap and mutates them in setWeather without synchronization.
findings.title: Unsynchronized list mutation in WeatherService.setWeather

findings.impact: Potential NPE if clan is null, and non-leader or forged menu state could trigger clan deletion if reached.
findings.root_cause: CONFIRM_DISSOLUTION_CLAN calls clan.deleteDB(clan.id) without null-checking player.clan or verifying clan.isLeader(player).
findings.title: Missing null and leader check in CONFIRM_DISSOLUTION_CLAN

findings.impact: Increases maintenance burden and risk of divergent bug fixes across dungeon map-entry rules.
findings.root_cause: MapService.getMapCanJoin duplicates the ~40-line mob/boss-dead check 4 times for DoanhTrai, BanDoKhoBau, KhiGasHuyDiet, and ConDuongRanDoc; MapService.goToMap duplicates ChangeMapService.goToMap.
findings.title: Duplicated dungeon clearance logic and goToMap method in MapService

findings.impact: Dead code clutter in npc_list package.
findings.root_cause: Entire class definitions are commented out.
findings.title: Fully commented-out NPC classes ShopNew and ToriBot

key_classes.name: NpcFactory
key_classes.responsibility: Instantiates all map NPCs by template ID and handles global menu callbacks for Shenron (RongThieng) and ConMeo dialogs.

key_classes.name: ChangeMapService
key_classes.responsibility: Handles map/zone transitions, spaceship/yardrat/waypoint movement, map access gating, and post-load effect synchronization.

key_classes.name: MapService
key_classes.responsibility: Provides map/zone lookup, dungeon progression checks, capsule destination lists, and map type predicates.

key_classes.name: SmartDropService
key_classes.responsibility: Adaptive beginner gear drop engine with 8 power tiers, anti-duplicate scanning, pity counter, and bonus stats/star slots.

key_classes.name: NpcService
key_classes.responsibility: Sends NPC dialog menus (opcode 32), tutorials (opcode 38), and NPC chat bubbles (opcode 124) to clients.

key_classes.name: WeatherService
key_classes.responsibility: Manages map-level atmospheric EffectMap presets and broadcasts updates to players.

key_classes.name: ItemMapService
key_classes.responsibility: Handles ground item pickup throttling and removal/disappear packets.

key_classes.name: NpcManager
key_classes.responsibility: Queries loaded NPCs by template/map and filters visible NPCs for a player's current map.

module_summary: Covers 18 NPC implementations in npc_list, NpcFactory (global RONG_THIENG/CON_MEO menu handlers), and core map/NPC/drop/weather services in services/map (ChangeMapService, MapService, ItemMapService, NpcManager, NpcService, SmartDropService, WeatherService).

protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: byte count, then UTF mapName and UTF planetName per zone for Capsule/BlackBall/MaBu tabs.
byte zoneCount; per zone: byte zoneId, byte status, byte numPlayers, byte maxPlayer, byte isCompeting (+ UTF/int rank1, rank2 if 1).
Skill/effect state sync on map join (shielding 33, thoi mien 41, stun/blind 40, troi 32) for mobs and players.
byte 0, int owner/mobMe id, short tempId, int hp for mobMe sync.
byte 1, byte mob.id, short 4133 for mob socola state on map join.
int player.id, byte typeSpace for spaceship arrive effect.
int player.id broadcast to zone when player exits map.
short seconds, byte type for transition effect (future/BDKB/Gas).
short itemMapId broadcast to zone when ground item disappears.
int player.id, short x, short y broadcast player position to others in map.
short npcTempId, UTF npcSay, byte menuCount, UTF[] menuSelect, optional short avatar.
short npcTempId, UTF npcSay, optional short avatar for NPC tutorial dialog.
short npcTempId, UTF text for NPC chat bubble.
short skillId (and byte -1 for subcommand 62) when learning/upgrading skills via HOC_KY_NANG.
